description: This file contains unit tests for the EncounterValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for Encounter objects.

classes.name: EncounterValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class for EncounterValidator, extends BaseContextSensitiveTest to support Spring context and database interactions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes EncounterValidator, Encounter, and Errors objects before each test.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenNull
methods.description: Tests that validate method throws IllegalArgumentException when given null object.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenInstanceOfOtherClassThanEncounter
methods.description: Tests that validate method throws IllegalArgumentException when given a non-Encounter object.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfThePatientsForTheVisitAndTheEncounterDontMatch
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when encounter's patient and visit's patient do not match.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheVisitHasNoPatient
methods.description: Ensures validation detects when encounter has a visit with no patient assigned.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientIsNotSet
methods.description: Confirms validation fails if the encounter's patient is not set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterDateTimeIsBeforeVisitStartDateTime
methods.description: Tests that encounter date-time before visit start date is invalid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterDateTimeIsAfterVisitStopDateTime
methods.description: Tests that encounter date-time after visit stop date is invalid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterDateTimeIsAfterCurrentDateTime
methods.description: Checks that encounter date-time after current system time is invalid.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterDateTimeIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures encounter date-time must be set.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterTypeIsNotSet
methods.description: Validates that encounter type must be specified.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that valid encounter fields pass validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Ensures that overly long voidReason fails validation.
